source.notes: ICSE Grade IX school Unit Test - I in Science (school not named). Header prints 'GRADE - IX', 'UNIT TEST - I', 'SCIENCE', 'M.M:- 60'; the paper has Section A (Physics) 20 marks, Section B (Chemistry) 20 marks and Section C (Biology) 20 marks. This pack holds only Section B (Chemistry), so maxMarks is that section's printed 20. No year or duration is printed; examYear 2024 is taken from the file name (icse-class-9-ut1-science-030424-2024, i.e. 03-04-2024). Marks are printed per question group; where a group total covers several sub-items with no per-item marks, the group is kept as one entry with that total. The scan carries a student's ticks and some handwritten additions, which were ignored. No answer key is printed; no official answers exist.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.

questions.text:
Balance the following equation:-
1. KClO₃ → KCl + O₂
2. Fe + H₂O → Fe₂O₃
3. NH₃ + Cl₂ → N₂ + HCl
4. PbO + NH₃ → Pb + H₂O + N₂
